xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5152: Jira as a full issue tracker: adapter, dashboard, lifecycle, CLI, settings and docs

plan.title: Jira as a full issue tracker: adapter, dashboard, lifecycle, CLI, settings and docs
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator scoped one issue whose acceptance criteria span the adapter, dashboard, lifecycle, CLI, settings and docs. A tracker: jira project is unsafe to ship while any write path still falls through to Linear or GitHub (close-out aborts with HTTP 422, the merge handoff rethrows, GitHub-first routing writes to GitHub issue #N), so independently shipped slices would release a tracker that corrupts state. The plan is decomposed into 29 small items with a strict DAG so the work agent can fan out; the surface is wide but each item is narrow.

narratives.Problem: Teams that track work in Jira cannot use Overdeck. Jira exists only as three dead leftovers. No adapter, config, credentials, polling or docs exist, and every write path falls through to Linear, while GitHub-first routing would misroute a Jira project whose code lives on GitHub.
narratives.Proposal: Add a fetch-based JiraTracker (Cloud v3 and Data Center v2) with its own HTTP client, ADF/wiki converters and status mapper; route tracker: jira projects away from GitHub issue resolution while keeping PR lookup; send every Jira write through one non-failing seam (jira-lifecycle.ts) that lifecycle, close-out, reopen, spawn and pan done call; poll Jira into the dashboard on the Rally cycle; add Settings rows, Add-project and CLI support, pan doctor checks and full docs. The PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-5152.md is the implementation brief; every item names its PRD work item.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Jira webhooks, Jira Service Management request types, sprints, boards and time tracking.
- OAuth 2.0 (3LO) sign-in; API token and personal access token only.
- Trello support.
- Jira project keys containing digits or underscores.
- Shadow mode for Jira (no shadow.trackers.jira key).
- Jira in the command-deck.ts sync-discussions endpoint.
- Changing GitHub-first precedence for any tracker other than jira; the PAN-2449 shape (tracker: linear + github_repo) must keep resolving to GitHub.
- Writing workflow labels to Jira or auto-creating missing Jira statuses.
- Any new npm dependency, any Jira SDK, or any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap raise.
- A Jira write that fails or blocks a merge, close-out, reopen or pan done.
- Reaper (isTrackerIssueClosed) reading Jira issues as closed; it stays false for Jira (D-23).
- Jira branches for pan close --abandon and the pan sync drift checks (D-24).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one plan with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator scoped one issue; partial slices would ship a Jira tracker whose writes fall through to Linear or GitHub (close-out 422, merge-handoff rethrow).

autoDecisions.summary: Only tracker: jira outranks github_repo in routing; other trackers keep GitHub-first precedence.
autoDecisions.rationale: Registered projects shaped tracker: linear + github_repo have GitHub issues and depend on GitHub-first order (PAN-2449).

autoDecisions.summary: Add resolveGitHubPullRequestRepo for the PR-repo callers instead of changing resolveGitHubIssue semantics everywhere.
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveGitHubIssue has about 40 callers; only 3 need the PR repo, so the narrow split keeps every other caller unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Every Jira write goes through jira-lifecycle.ts, which never rejects.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-6 says a tracker write never blocks a merge; merge-agent rethrows and close-out returns 422 on a failed write, so the guarantee belongs at one seam.

autoDecisions.summary: FR-8 reinterpreted: pan done and close-out call linkJiraPullRequest; pan done --comment posts the Linear agent-completed text; close-out posts a close comment with the PR URL.
autoDecisions.rationale: linkPR has no caller today and pan done posts no PR comment on any tracker, so the issue premise does not match the code.

autoDecisions.summary: AC2 satisfied through getTrackerContext (work agent) and buildPlanningPrompt (planner).
autoDecisions.rationale: The work prompt template has no title or description slot; tracker content reaches the work agent only through getTrackerContext.

autoDecisions.summary: The Jira project key is the project issue_prefix; keys are letters only.
autoDecisions.rationale: parseIssueId and the issue-prefix-invalid check accept letters only (PAN-4860); one value cannot drift.

autoDecisions.summary: Credentials are three flat tracker_keys (jira, jira_email, jira_base_url) shown as three Settings rows.
autoDecisions.rationale: TrackerKeysSection renders one string input per key; a nested object would need a new component.

autoDecisions.summary: The Add-project dialog gains an Issue tracker select (Detect from remote / Jira) and a Jira site URL field.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-11 asks the flow to accept jira and the dialog has no tracker picker today.

autoDecisions.summary: The state-mapping.ts jira entry becomes the live default status map; in_planning writes only when status_map.in_planning is set.
autoDecisions.rationale: It already holds sensible Jira default names; Jira has no default planning status.

Add the Jira REST client with auth, 30 s timeout, 429 retry and deployment detection (PRD WI-5)

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Creates a new file (jira-api.ts) and its own test; no other item edits them.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5 and decision D-16. Create JiraRestApi in src/lib/tracker/jira-api.ts: site normalization, apiPath (v3 cloud / v2 datacenter), Basic auth for cloud and Bearer for datacenter, AbortController + setTimeout 30 s timeout (never AbortSignal.timeout), 429 retry honoring Retry-After (default 5, cap 60, max 3 retries), 401/403 to TrackerAuthError with jiraCredentialFix(), 404 on an issue path to IssueNotFoundError, other non-2xx to TrackerError with method, path and status only. Add detectJiraDeployment with the .atlassian.net shortcut and a per-site cache of GET /rest/api/2/serverInfo. Never put the token, email or Authorization header in any message or log. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers and runtime-built fake tokens.
